scenes.title: Your spreadsheet looks like it lost a fight.
scenes.body: Merged cells, rainbow tabs, and mystery columns are not a system. They are a crime scene.
scenes.voice: Your spreadsheet looks like it lost a fight in a parking lot. Merged cells, rainbow tabs, and mystery columns are not a system. They are a crime scene with formulas.

scenes.title: Make it useful for a stranger tomorrow.
scenes.body: If someone else has to reverse-engineer your work, you still have a problem.
scenes.voice: The goal is not pretty. The goal is useful for a stranger tomorrow. If someone else has to reverse-engineer your work, you still have a problem.

scenes.title: Kill the merged cells.
scenes.body: Unmerge everything. One value per cell. Headers only in row one. No exceptions.
scenes.voice: Step one. Kill the merged cells. Unmerge everything. One value per cell. Headers only in row one. No artistic exceptions.

scenes.title: One tab, one purpose.
scenes.body: Raw data. Clean data. Working calc. Dashboard. Name the tabs so a human understands them.
scenes.voice: Step two. One tab, one purpose. Raw data. Clean data. Working calculations. Dashboard. Name the tabs so a human understands them without a decoder ring.

scenes.title: Fix the headers and freeze them.
scenes.body: Clear names. No abbreviations only you understand. Freeze the top row. Filter on.
scenes.voice: Step three. Fix the headers and freeze them. Clear names. No secret abbreviations. Freeze the top row. Turn filters on. Instant dignity.

scenes.title: Delete the dead weight.
scenes.body: Empty columns. Old notes. #REF! ghosts. Hidden sheets that still calculate. Gone.
scenes.voice: Step four. Delete the dead weight. Empty columns. Old notes. Hash R E F ghosts. Hidden sheets that still calculate in the background. Gone.

scenes.title: Document the non-obvious.
scenes.body: One cell comment or a tiny Notes tab explaining any formula that is not self-evident.
scenes.voice: Step five. Document the non-obvious. One cell comment or a tiny Notes tab that explains any formula that is not self-evident. Future you will send past you a thank-you card.

scenes.title: Pick the ugliest sheet. Fix it today.
scenes.body: Use the checklist. Save a before copy. Then make the after version the only version that lives.
scenes.voice: Your next move. Pick the ugliest sheet you have. Fix it today with this checklist. Save a before copy for comedy. Then make the after version the only version that lives.
